title: Learning a PRECISE language for small-molecule binding
authors: Mert Erden; Xuting Zhang; Kapil Devkota; Rohit Singh; Lenore Cowen
one_liner_zh: 该文提出PRECISE方法，利用量化小分子表示与目标蛋白3D表面网格的几何深度学习匹配来预测小分子结合位点，虽聚焦小分子-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA体系，但其表面表征与结合位点识别方法可迁移至蛋白质-DNA互作建模。
abstract: Virtual screening of billion-scale compound libraries has become feasible through machine learning approaches. In particular, CoNCISE (RECOMB 2025) introduced drug quantization via code-books, achieving highly scalable and accurate binary predictions. However, drug discovery requires understanding not just whether molecules bind, but where they bind and how to target specific sites. Here, we present PRECISE which leverages CoNCISE’s quantized small-molecule representations while operating on the target’s 3D structure as its input. The key innovation of PRECISE is reimagining drug-target interaction as compatibility between quantized drug embeddings and a latent representation of the target’s surface mesh, enriched with electrostatic and geometric features. PRECISE designs a novel surface representation, interpreted through a geometric deep learning architecture, enabling it to identify binding sites more accurately than state-of-the-art methods (DiffDock-L, Chai, and Boltz-2) while the codebook ensures billion-scale screening capability. Our formulation unlocks zero-shot generalization to complex targets such as metalloproteins and multi-chain complexes. To enable efficient integration with downstream docking workflows, we introduce P recise -MCTS, which combines fast P recise -based screening with selective Vina docking through an iterative Monte Carlo Tree Search approach. By providing both mechanistic understanding and massive scalability, PRECISE delivers capabilities that were previously mutually exclusive in virtual screening.
abstract_zh: 通过机器学习方法，对十亿级化合物库进行虚拟筛选已成为可行。特别是，CoNCISE（RECOMB 2025）通过码本引入了药物量化，实现了高度可扩展且准确的二元预测。然而，药物发现不仅需要理解分子是否结合，还需要理解它们在哪里结合以及如何靶向特定位点。在此，我们提出PRECISE，它利用CoNCISE的量化小分子表示，同时以靶标的3D结构作为输入进行操作。PRECISE的关键创新在于将药物-靶标相互作用重新构想为量化药物嵌入与靶标表面网格潜在表示之间的兼容性，并富集了静电和几何特征。PRECISE设计了一种新颖的表面表示，通过几何深度学习架构进行解释，使其能够比最先进的方法（DiffDock-L、Chai和Boltz-2）更准确地识别结合位点，同时码本确保了十亿级筛选能力。我们的公式解锁了对复杂靶标（如金属蛋白和多链复合物）的零样本泛化。为了与下游对接流程高效集成，我们引入了P recise -MCTS，它通过迭代蒙特卡洛树搜索方法，将基于P recise 的快速筛选与选择性Vina对接相结合。通过提供机制理解和巨大可扩展性，PRECISE实现了在虚拟筛选中以前相互排斥的能力。
